decisive_items: large deep-cratered solitary ulcer on the anterior rectal wall with firm margins, friability, and exudate
mild straining with bowel movements and occasional passage of mucus
Normal appearance of remainder of rectum without radiation-induced changes
response.rationale: The solitary anterior rectal wall ulcer with normal surrounding mucosa, straining, and mucus is characteristic of a benign rectal ulcer, likely solitary rectal ulcer syndrome. Radiation proctitis is less likely because the remainder of the rectum is explicitly normal without radiation-induced changes and a hydrogel spacer was used to protect the rectum.

rejected.why: Radiation proctitis would typically produce more diffuse radiation-induced mucosal changes; the normal remainder of the rectum and presence of a protective spacer argue against it despite the radiation history.
